what: the three edges at one box corner rounded r3, Corners: Curvature set back 3.5, just past the radius: the smallest kind of setback that builds
method: box 40x30x20, the edges at (40,30,20) rounded r3, corner g2, with the setback 3.5: past where the rounds' contact lines meet (r = 3 from the vertex on a corner of faces square to each other), so the patch is built (the rule: a setback must be more than the radius). No closed-form volume (a fitted patch): one valid body of 10 faces within the box. Graded as fillets/9-fillet-corner-r5-curvature-default-setback, scaled by r: at the points where a round's section ends on a face the round is only tangent (G1) to the plane, its curvature jumping by 1/r, so no patch is G2 to both there; the patch's curvature jump is bounded at stations at least 0.24 r from each turn, within 2.2 r of the corner, at most 0.5% of 1/r per mm.
